exposure_audit.note: Read from each selected attempt's result.json exposure block. A cell without a completed attempt has no exposure receipt and is counted, never imputed.

integrity.ledger: no cells.jsonl in the run directory

methods.ci: family cluster percentile bootstrap (type-7 quantiles), common resamples per family set
methods.denominators: every expected cell is retained; Missing and InfraInterrupted cells and non-submitted exits count as failures (0)
methods.interpretation_limit: A CI containing zero is not evidence of no effect; secondary results are descriptive.
methods.multiplicity: Holm across primary contrasts; secondary contrasts are exploratory and unadjusted
methods.p_value: family-level sign-flip permutation test; exact when n_families <= exact_max_log2, else Monte Carlo (1+hits)/(1+draws)
methods.unit: families are the independent units; item values average the declared seeds; family values average items

primary.multiplicity: Holm step-down across the declared primary contrasts

cost.note: Costs are per episode over cells whose selected attempt has accounting; cells without accounting are counted, never imputed. all_attempts includes interrupted and non-selected attempts.

natural_missed_recovered.note: fraction of the natural-variant missed callers recovered; non-submitted cells count as 0; cells without a scored value are reported, not imputed

over_caution.note: Over-caution on complete items: completeness claims other than 'yes', precision and the paired per-item cost difference against the reference arm (descriptive).
